description: A receipt stored in a player's repository confirming they unlocked a game achievement.

main.description: Published in the player's own PDS when an achievement is earned. Supports solo or co-op squad clears (`participants` + `runId`), RPG Hall-of-Fame / roguelike / cozy victory context (`details` + commemorative `media` snapshot), optional inline CID-first cryptographic `signatures`, and moderation via `games.opengaming.revocation` records and/or ATProto Labelers.

achievement.description: AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.achievement.definition` record in the game publisher's repository.

definitionCid.description: Optional CID snapshot of the `achievement.definition` record at the moment of unlock. Kept optional and decoupled from `achievement` so cosmetic/typo edits to the definition never orphan player unlocks.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition (`games.atmosphere.define`), included so indexers can group unlocks by game without an extra lookup.

player.description: DID of the player who earned this achievement (must match the repository DID housing this record).

unlockedAt.description: Timestamp when the achievement was earned.

stepsCompleted.description: Optional final step count reached when unlocking an incremental achievement.

participants.description: Optional roster of co-op teammates, duo partners, or raid party members who earned this achievement together.

runId.description: Optional shared deterministic session/clear identifier linking co-op teammates' unlock receipts (or correlating an unlock to a matching `leaderboard.score`).

details.description: Optional open-union clear context (e.g. `games.opengaming.defs#unlockContext` for RPG Hall-of-Fame parties, roguelike loadouts, cozy catches, or any game-defined `$type` object).

media.description: Optional commemorative screenshot, victory card, photo, or postcard stored in the player's PDS alongside the unlock.

note.description: Optional commemorative caption or player/game note attached to the unlock.

signatures.description: Optional inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`) over the repository-bound DAG-CBOR CID of this record. Kept optional so clients can still write unlocks directly to the player's PDS in serverless or post-EoS environments.
